title: Enhance Product Information Display
description: Improve the visibility of detailed product information, including size guides and fabric details, on wishlist items. This addresses the barrier of 'insufficient product information' (10 occurrences) and 'fit uncertainty' (20 occurrences), which currently lead to decision delays.

title: Streamlined Return Process Information
description: Create a dedicated section for clear return policies and processes on product pages and wishlists. This targets the 'returns/exchange friction' barrier (227 occurrences) that is causing users to abandon their purchases.

title: Fit Visualization Tool
description: Develop a fit visualization tool that allows users to see how items fit based on their measurements. This addresses the high uncertainty around fit (20 occurrences) and could help high uncertainty shoppers make more confident purchase decisions.

title: Delivery Time Estimates on Wishlist Items
description: Integrate estimated delivery times for wishlist items based on user location. This directly addresses the 'delivery timing' barrier (225 occurrences) that leads to frustration and postponement in purchasing.

title: Personalized Recommendations Based on Wishlist
description: Implement a recommendation engine that suggests similar items based on wishlist contents, focusing on quality and fit. This could help high uncertainty shoppers (5 occurrences) by providing alternatives that may better meet their needs.

title: User Feedback Loop for Wishlist Items
description: Create a feedback mechanism where users can share their experiences with wishlist items post-purchase. This will help gather insights on 'genuine intention to buy later' (58 occurrences) and improve future recommendations.

title: Comprehensive User Experience Overhaul
description: Conduct a full redesign of the wishlist and checkout experience, focusing on reducing friction points identified in the report, such as delivery timing and returns friction. This transformative initiative aims to significantly enhance user satisfaction and conversion rates.

title: AI-Powered Customer Support Chatbot
description: Develop an AI-powered chatbot that can assist users with common queries related to wishlist items, delivery, and returns. This initiative addresses the high frequency of customer service-related issues (145 occurrences) and aims to improve user trust and engagement.
